generator_cmd: sh vmbc_gen.sh   # vmbc_asm.py (stdlib) assembles the program, system python3 zlib.crc32 header, coreutils base64, gcc 15.2
oracle_cmd: sh vmbc_oracle.sh vmbc_gcc_O0_b64.bin   # -DORACLE twin run natively + nm -S/readelf -SW for prog
note: gcc -O0 -no-pie: compare-tree dispatch (no jump table), program stores the base64 TEXT of the blob into .bss; lib.binary.hcfg_scan -> first valid hit (offset = bytecode blob start, SPECULATIVE)
